question: A store had 72 items. In the morning, they removed 66. They multiplied by 5. They added 45. They tripled the count. They multiplied by 5. Finally, they divided by 5 for equal distribution. How many items per location?

A warehouse started with 126 boxes. In the morning, they removed 108. They multiplied remaining by 8. They added 17 more. They tripled the count. What is the total in terms of dozens (converting to time-based hours)?
A store had 52 items. In the morning, they multiplied by 5. By afternoon, they lost 91. In the evening, they doubled the total. They added 71 items. They removed 287. How many items remain?
A farm had 27 crops. In spring, they quadrupled. In summer, they multiplied by 8. They added 32. In fall, they removed 89. In winter, they divided by 3. How many crops per sector?

A company started with 238 employees. Morning announcement: added 45. They tripled the workforce through hiring. They added 22 in the afternoon. They tripled again. They multiplied by 7 for projections. How many employees does the company project?
A store began with 94 items. Production multiplied by 5. They added 33 items. They removed 48. They added 16. They multiplied by 6 at year end. How many items are in the store?
A team scored 146 points. By halftime, they added 78. By three-quarter time, they added 72. By end, they added 56. In overtime, they added 61. How many points (as a word quantity)?
A warehouse had 194 units. In Q1, they added 61. In Q2, they added 40. In Q3, they removed 36. In Q4, they added 77. They had a distractor about a 9-unit batch. How many units remain?
A theater had 210 seats. In the morning, they removed 156 for repair. By afternoon, they added 15. By evening, they multiplied capacity 7 times. By night, they doubled. How many seats are available?

A library had 64 books at the start. In the morning, they removed 27 for cleaning. By afternoon, they added 26. By evening, they multiplied by 4 for a display. They multiplied by 8 for branch distribution. They added 46. How many books were distributed?

A company started with 185 units. Production multiplied 8 times. They added 52 from inventory. They removed 844 due to market change. They removed 323 more due to recalls. They added 49 replacements. How many units remain?

A student had 178 minutes of study time. By morning, they added 23 minutes. By afternoon, they added 74 minutes (converted to hours: divide by 5). By evening, they multiplied by 8. Finally, they divided by 4. How many hours of study?
A factory started with 148 units. They doubled for Q1. They multiplied by 5 for Q2. They removed 267 in Q3. They added 54 in Q4. They doubled the year-end total. How many units are projected?
A store had 51 items. They multiplied by 7. They added 78. They divided by 3 for distribution. They doubled the count. They removed 37. How many items per store?

A warehouse started with 188 boxes. They multiplied by 9 for the holiday season. They divided by 6 for distribution centers. They added 55 boxes per center. They added 79 more. They removed 334. How many boxes per center?
A team started with 157 points. In the first half, they added 12. They removed 72. They multiplied by 9. They removed 717. They multiplied by 5. How many points does the team have?
Two players had 95 marbles combined. Player A removed 89. Player A added 50. Player A added 6 more. Player A added 37. How many marbles does Player A have (as a proportion)?

A library started with 226 books. In spring, they removed 121. In summer, they added 17. In fall, they multiplied by 5. In winter, they added 51. They doubled the collection for year-end assessment. How many books does the library have?
Two friends combined their collections: 168 items. Friend A added 69 items. Together they added 23 more. They multiplied by 9. They lost 2,178 items. How many items remain?

Two players combined 84 tokens. They divided in half. Player A multiplied their half by 9. Player A multiplied by 9 again. Player A removed 509 tokens. Player A multiplied by 7. How many tokens does Player A have?
A farm had 79 crops. In spring, they quadrupled. In summer, they added 60. In fall, they added 34. In winter, they quadrupled again for storage preparation. How many crops are stored?

A player had 87 cards. By the first game, they added 20. By the second game, they removed 71. By the third game, they doubled the count. By the final round, they divided by 3 (equally among teammates). How many cards per player?

A team scored 132 points. In round 1, they added 4. In round 2, they multiplied by 8. In round 3, they added 65. In round 4, they added 17. They multiplied by 5. They multiplied by 3 in overtime. How many points did they score?
A player started with 24 tokens. They added 25. They removed 2. They removed 4 more. They tripled the remaining for a final hand. How many tokens does the player have?
Two players had 77 marbles. Player B removed 2. Player B added 36. Player B added 5 more. Player B removed 32. Player B divided by 6 for tournament rounds. How many marbles per round?
